title: Kneaded Buttery Portuguese Yoghurt Pasta
description: A buttery and tender Portuguese dish featuring natural yoghurt, this vegan-friendly pasta is kneaded to perfection, making it a truly indulgent treat. It combines the richness of butter with the creaminess of yoghurt.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the vegan butter to the skillet and stir until melted and smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the natural yoghurt and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the cooked pasta to the bowl with the yoghurt mixture and toss until the pasta is well coated.
Add the garlic and butter mixture to the bowl and toss until the pasta is well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Knead the pasta mixture for about 5 minutes until it is smooth and elastic.
Let the pasta rest for a few minutes before serving.
